meta.name: Pineglass Forest — Needle Bend
meta.notes: Routing audit: a non-crossing triangular loop with approximately 72.7 m and 81.3 m woodland walks, safe transformed rough envelopes, and the opening tee and finishing green on opposite sides of the clubhouse clearing. Needle Bend is a 42-43.5 m strategic par-4 corridor with alternating landing-edge bunkers. Fern Gate is intentionally semi-blind: its 165-yard line and raised entry are readable from the tee while the putting surface reveals from the approach. Glasswood Reach alternates a drive-right bunker, lay-up-left bunker, and paired greenside guards. Mature forest rooms use catalog-backed pine structure over pine-needle litter; openings remain deliberate rather than uniform.
